answer: Clone surveyors fail a one-cut quarry intake. After locking 17.6 POA, the applicant has 33 minutes to drill core DC-14 from reef face RF-08 at chainage 226.4 m, haul it to ridge bench RB-3, and dust 4.0 g onto saffron paper SP-19 so scanner SC-6 records a 12-line XRD match to plate PL-44 within 0.8%. A second core from the same key cluster, a chainage miss over 0.5 m, or a reused paper lot burns the 17.6 POA and bars quarry keys for five epochs. Two geology clerks rehash the XRD file and plate serial.
